What exists by dataset, country and variable

Source: R/summary.R
soil_availability.Rd

Counts the features, horizons and observations of a selection by dataset, by country and by variable, with the meaning of each source variable in each dataset (POST /query/availability, canonical = true). A feature assigned to several countries (the country filter of the API selects the features that intersect a country) counts under each of them, so the country rows must not be summed: the dataset totals count every feature once. Features without a country are grouped under an NA country.

Usage

soil_availability(
  soil = soil_session(),
  datasets = NULL,
  variables = NULL,
  bbox = NULL,
  country = NULL,
  geometry = "any",
  layer = "all",
  view = "raw",
  profile_type = NULL,
  components = NULL,
  min_cumulative_percent = NULL
)

Arguments

soil

A session; the default session when omitted. Client-side: not sent to the API.

datasets

Catalog dataset codes ("wosis_points", "wise_profiles", "soter_profiles", "soter_polygons", "sotwis_polygons", "sotwis_components", "sotwis_estimates", see soil_datasets()); NULL (the API default) selects every dataset, usually above the limit of synchronous reads. API field datasets.

variables

Source codes ("ORGC", "CLAY") or canonical property keys ("organic_carbon"), see soil_variables(); NULL returns every variable. With variables the column set is fixed by the request, so every page has the same columns. API field variables.

bbox

c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) in WGS84 degrees (longitude, latitude). API field bbox.

country

Countries as ISO 3166 alpha-2 or alpha-3 codes or names, case-insensitive (the API resolves them). API field country.

geometry

"any", "point" (profiles) or "polygon" (map units). API field geometry.

layer

"all" horizons, or "first": the first horizon(s) of each profile with first_layer_status and profile_markings (see soil_first_layer()). API field layer.

view

"raw": the ISRIC mirror as stored (sent explicitly); "revised": the decided rules of the revised view applied by the API in the response (see soil_revised_rules()). API field view.

profile_type

Profiles by the source's own type term: "synthetic" (KENSOTER), "virtual" (Upper Tana), "none" (no type in the source record), all selecting or all excluded with a "!" prefix (c("!synthetic", "!virtual")); NULL keeps every profile. API field profile_type.

components

Components of multi-component map units (SOTWIS, SOTER polygons): NULL (the API default, "representative"), "representative" (largest proportion_percent), "all", or "cumulative" (by decreasing proportion until min_cumulative_percent). API field components.

min_cumulative_percent

Threshold of components = "cumulative", 0 to 100 (required with it, refused without it). API field min_cumulative_percent.

Value

A soil_availability list of data frames:

  • datasets: one row per dataset, dataset, geometry ("point", "polygon"), feature_count, horizon_count, observation_count (distinct totals of the dataset);

  • countries: country_code, country_name, feature_count, horizon_count, observation_count;

  • dataset_countries: one row per dataset and country, the same counts (by_dataset of the API);

  • variables: one row per dataset, country and source variable: dataset, country_code, country_name, property_code (the source code), canonical_property_key, canonical_name, property_family, source_unit, procedure_code, procedure_description, source_value_kind, mapping_status, documentation_url, source_notes, variants (list of data frames source_scope, canonical_property_key, source_unit, source_notes: the meanings of the code in parts of the dataset), feature_count, horizon_count, observation_count;

and metadata (see soil_metadata()).

Details

The arguments are the selection of soil_observations(), validated the same way before any request.

Rights: soil:summary. Capabilities: canonical_summary; revised_view for view = "revised", profile_type_filter for profile_type, component_selection for components.

See also

Other summaries: soil_consistency(), soil_summary()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
a <- soil_availability(soil, datasets = "soter_profiles", country = "KEN")
a$datasets
totc <- a$variables[a$variables$property_code == "TOTC", ]
totc[, c("country_code", "source_unit", "observation_count")]
} # }
